answer: One concrete defense is an open sybil-bounty market backed by symmetric challenge bonds. Any peer may challenge a suspect identity by matching its registration bond; if the suspect fails a fresh liveness-and-work proof, its whole stake is slashed and paid to the challenger. Every fake then dangles a standing bounty, so a thousand sybils post a thousand prizes for hunters to claim. Honest agents stand like marble while cheap imitations, however smooth their velvet cover, cannot wander the ledger for long before a profit-seeking challenger strips the deposit.
